Messages.Author: Jaysen Knight
Messages.Body:
My impression has always been that the contesting cost has to be paid
before I can yield the contested card in question. How does this
work again?

Jaysen

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


During your untap, you either contest (by paying the cost to contest) or
yield (by not paying the cost to contest) each card/title another
Methuselah/vampire is contesting with you (or that you are contesting
with yourself).

So, if you choose to yield, you don't pay the cost.
